criteria.text: Each Tool and Chat screen has one compact title/navigation header rather than stacked large-title/breadcrumb headers.
criteria.test_id: issue-1235-c1: every chat and tool surface owns exactly one compact header

criteria.text: Chat header contains back navigation, human-readable session title, concise running/connection status, and a three-dot overflow menu.
criteria.test_id: issue-1235-c2: chat header exposes navigation, title, status, and overflow

criteria.text: Settings and Manage move to the overflow menu; Files Changed appears as a compact button/badge only when relevant.
criteria.test_id: issue-1235-c3: Settings and Manage live in overflow and Files Changed is conditional

criteria.text: Tool screens combine Tool identity and applicable actions into the same compact header.
criteria.test_id: issue-1235-c4: tool identity and actions share the compact tool header

criteria.text: Raw session IDs and mobile breadcrumbs such as `Agents / Chats / <sessionId>` are not used as prominent titles.
criteria.test_id: issue-1235-c5: raw session IDs and breadcrumbs are never prominent titles

criteria.text: Safe-area behavior, keyboard presentation, scrolling, VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, and landscape layouts remain usable.
criteria.reason: Static accessibility and safe-area contracts are automated, but largest Dynamic Type, landscape, and keyboard-visible usability require the issue's physical-device review.

criteria.text: The change increases usable content height without shrinking touch targets below platform guidance.
criteria.reason: The structural contract enforces 44-point controls and removal of the persistent chat row; physical-device review must confirm the resulting usable height.
